snippet.title: Spirited Line - Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Try Demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3826420/Spirited_Line/

Spirited Line is a short, tightly designed boss-rush hack and slash game built around simple, skill-based combat and epic battles. To escape the strange underground world, you must face a series of intense duels against powerful spirits — each one guarding their own mysterious station.

As you fight your way deeper through the haunted subway, you’ll uncover fragments of its forgotten past, revealed through the guidance of an old Janitor and the bizarre world around you.

Developer: Eazy Wizard
X: https://x.com/Eazy_Wizard

#indiegame #hackandslash #bossrush
